description: Rename a note. The name stays even when the first line changes later, as when renaming in the app. Changes nothing inside the note. Password-locked notes cannot be renamed from here. Never use em dashes or en dashes in a note's name. Ordinary hyphens are fine.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

title.description: The note's new name, at most 120 characters. An empty string gives the note back its automatic name, its first line.

name: scratchpad_rename_note
title: Rename note
